correctness.rationale: For all n>=1 under a fully specified continuous simple null, the Watson kernel h(x,y)=1/12-|x-y|/2+|x-y|^2/2 is canonical and has constant diagonal 1/12; the Anderson-Darling kernel a(x,y)=integral Y_xY_y/[t(1-t)]dt is canonical. Thus only matching unordered off-diagonal pairs contribute to covariance, giving 2(n-1)/n E[ha]. Independent symbolic Brownian-bridge integration reduced its inner product to integral_0^1 s(1-s)/12 ds=1/72, yielding Cov=(n-1)/(36n). The variances Var(U)= (n-1)/(360n) and Var(A)=[4-pi^2/3+2(n-1)(pi^2/3-3)]/n then give stated monotone correlation and n=1 undefined correlation. Hypotheses exclude parameter estimation.
